sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is Z.ai's first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. It is a 320B Mixture-of-Experts model with 18B active parameters, built for coding, agentic work, and visual tasks, and released under the MIT License.

sources.title: Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a ...
sources.snippet: Z.ai has released GLM-5.3-Flash, the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series and the cheapest capable coding model the lab has shipped. It is a mixture-of-experts model with 320B total parameters and 18B active per token, a 1,048,576-token context window, and image and video input — released under an MIT license with weights on Hugging Face. sources.title: GLM 5.3 Flash | Model APIs - runinfra.ai
sources.snippet: GLM 5.3 Flash is an LLM listed in RunInfra Model APIs. RunInfra serves it as zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash at $0.10 per 1M input tokens and $0.40 per 1M output tokens. Its context window is 1,048,576 tokens. The API provides OpenAI-compatible chat completions.
